⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ **10/10 – Perfect Fit & Clean Look**

Great privacy cover for the Elgato Facecam Pro. It fits perfectly, feels well made, and gives me peace of mind when I’m not using the camera. It also looks clean and doesn’t take away from the premium look of the Facecam Pro. Simple product, but it does exactly what it’s supposed to do. Definitely recommend!
